cited_share.entity: industry — global EV battery usage, all chemistries (CATL, BYD, LGES, CALB, Gotion, Panasonic, EVE, SK On, SVOLT, REPT)
cited_share.metric: Global EV/PHEV/HEV battery usage (batteries in vehicles registered worldwide) and supplier market share
cited_share.value: Total 725.2 GWh, +20.4% YoY (July alone 116.0 GWh, +22.1%). CATL 289.6 GWh / 39.9% share (+26.6% YoY; share 38.0%→39.9%); BYD 106.7 GWh / 14.7% (+4.7%; 16.9%→14.7%); LG Energy Solution 60.3 GWh / 8.3% (+4.5%; 9.6%→8.3%); CALB 37.3 GWh (+34.3%); Gotion 34.0 GWh (+44.2%); Panasonic 26.2 GWh / 3.6% (+7.6%; 4.0%→3.6%); EVE 25.0 GWh (+53.1%); SK On 22.3 GWh / 3.1% (−9.8%; 4.1%→3.1%); SVOLT 18.9 GWh (+39.1%); REPT 16.9 GWh (+118.5%, new entrant displacing Sunwoda). Seven Chinese suppliers in the top 10 = 72.8% combined (+3.1pp). CATL+BYD combined SHARE 54.6% (−0.3pp from 54.9%). LFP share of global usage 51.6%→56.1%; average pack size 34.5→38.6 kWh.
cited_share.source_name: SNE Research — Press Release (Insight), "From Jan to Jul 2026, Global EV Battery Usage Posted 725.2GWh" (English edition; data from its Global EV and Battery Monthly Tracker, August 2026)
cited_share.notes: BACKDROP ONLY — this is all-chemistry xEV battery usage (EV+PHEV+HEV, 80 countries aggregated), NOT solid-state. Nothing in it can be read across to solid-state share. Verifier fixes applied: CATL+BYD 54.6% is a SHARE, not GWh (the researcher wrote '54.6% GWh'); label the scope 'EV incl. PHEV/HEV', not BEV-only. The cited English URL (id 727) is SNE's own English twin of the Korean original at /en/insight/release_view/726/page/0, which carries Korean body text despite the /en/ path — both show 'Registration Date 2026-09-07' in the page body. Do NOT publish per-company shares for CALB, Gotion, EVE, SVOLT or REPT: SNE's text gives only GWh and YoY for those five; the circulating 5.1%/4.7%/3.5%/2.6%/2.3% figures come from CnEVPost reading SNE's chart image. CnEVPost is the downstream re-report — cite SNE.

cited_share.entity: industry — global EV battery usage EXCLUDING China (CATL, LGES, BYD, Panasonic, SK On, Samsung SDI, Gotion, SVOLT, CALB, EVE)
cited_share.metric: Global (ex-China) EV/PHEV/HEV battery usage and supplier market share
cited_share.source_name: SNE Research — Press Release (Insight), "Global (Ex-China) EV Battery Usage in January-July 2026 Reaches 316.2 GWh, Up 25.8% Year-on-Year"
cited_share.notes: BACKDROP ONLY, all chemistries. This is the more honest denominator for LGES / Samsung SDI / SK On / Panasonic, and it is the only free SNE release that gives a 2026 Samsung SDI number (SDI is absent from the China-inclusive top 10). The −10.4pp collapse in combined Korean share is the single most load-bearing share datapoint for the Korean names. Verifier fixes: CATL+BYD 44.6% is a SHARE not GWh (= 140.9 GWh); scope is xEV incl. hybrids. Shares for Gotion/SVOLT/CALB/EVE are not given in the release — do not compute and attribute them to SNE. 'Registration Date 2026-09-09' is in the page body, not a search snippet. Serves as the negative control proving the 725.2 GWh figure is genuinely China-inclusive.

shipments.metric: Composition of the cumulative LCB cell count — largest single customer application
shipments.value: more than 900,000 of the >2.4m cells went to one U.S. automotive AUDIO-SYSTEM customer across 175+ repeat orders
shipments.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Begins Mass Production of High-Energy-Density All-Solid-State Battery…"
shipments.notes: LOAD-BEARING CAVEAT to publish alongside the 2.4m figure: these are not EV traction cells. The composition line sits in the same release, but only the '>2.4 million' sentence was verbatim-verified by the adversarial check, hence medium confidence — re-read the release before printing the 900,000/175+ numbers. An independent trade outlet (carnewschina, 2026-09-06) makes the same warning explicitly: the total 'should not be interpreted as 2.4 million high-voltage EV traction cells'. Mix is consumer + specialty + automotive.

shipments.value: No GWh and no cell count of shipments has ever been disclosed. Customer SAMPLES/prototypes only — B0 prototype samples of QSE-5 in 2024, B1 prototypes in 2025, and in 2026 QSE-5 cells to an additional automotive OEM and to a major American defense prime. Eagle Line in San Jose is a PILOT line; company aims to 'further double cell output in the second half of 2026' with no absolute base given.
shipments.unit: none disclosed (no GWh, no unit count)
shipments.source_name: QuantumScape Corporation, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
shipments.notes: WORD THIS PRECISELY: say 'no GWh of cell shipments disclosed', never 'no GWh figure appears in the filing' — the 10-Q does contain four GWh figures (up to 40 / +40 / +5 / 85 GWh) and every one is PowerCo LICENSED CAPACITY, not QS volume. Anyone re-checking the page against this document will find '85 GWh' in it. The sample-shipment colour comes partly from the Q2 FY2026 shareholder letter (8-K EX-99.1, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1811414/000119312526312423/qs-ex99_1.htm), not solely from the 10-Q — cite that separately if leaned on. Filing date confirmed from the in-document signature block ('Date: July 24, 2026') and EDGAR metadata.

shipments.entity: ProLogium Technology 輝能科技 (Taiwan; unlisted, Nasdaq listing pending as PRLG via SPAC)
shipments.metric: Cumulative solid-state (Lithium Ceramic Battery, LCB) cells shipped since start of commercial production — the only company-confirmed cumulative shipment figure anywhere in this sweep
shipments.value: more than 2.4 million cells (a company-stated FLOOR, not a measured point value)
shipments.period: 2013 through H1 2025 — the last period for which ProLogium actually measured and published the figure; the same '>2.4 million' threshold was restated unchanged in the 2026-09-02 release
shipments.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Begins Mass Production of High-Energy-Density All-Solid-State Battery, Reaching 381 Wh/kg and 903 Wh/L" (company newsroom; GlobeNewswire wire copy)
shipments.notes: DO NOT label this 'cumulative through 2026-09-02'. ProLogium first announced crossing 2.4m units on 2025-07-01 ("As of H1 2025... shipped over 2.4 million", https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/07/01/3108084/0/en/ProLogium-s-Next-Generation-Lithium-Ceramic-Battery-Shipments-Surpass-2-4-Million-Units.html); the Sept 2026 release recycles the same boilerplate floor, so dating it to 2026-09-02 implies ~zero growth over 14 months of ramp, which is almost certainly false and backwards. Keep the words 'more than' — rendering it as '=2,400,000' overstates precision. Wire mirror (more durable archival link): https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/02/3354848/0/en/prologium-begins-mass-production-of-high-energy-density-all-solid-state-battery-reaching-381-wh-kg-and-903-wh-l.html (dateline 'TAIPEI, Taiwan, Sept. 02, 2026 03:00 ET' in body). Same release also confirms: Gen 3.5 185.4 Ah large-format cell now in mass production at the Taoyuan Giga-level facility, TÜV-measured 381 Wh/kg / 903 Wh/L, UL Solutions-tested as all-solid-state under GB/T 43568-2026. The Nasdaq/PRLG/SPAC framing is NOT in this release — cite TDAC's 8-K/425 filings separately for that.

capacity.metric: Licensed production ceiling under the PowerCo IP License Agreement — NOT built or announced plant capacity
capacity.value: up to 85 GWh annually (40 GWh + an additional 40 GWh + an additional 5 GWh), described in the filing as 'the potential maximum production by PowerCo under the PowerCo IP License Agreement'
capacity.source_name: QuantumScape Corporation, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
capacity.notes: MUST NOT be tabulated in a capacity column. It is a contractual ceiling on what a licensee may one day produce, not a line that exists, is funded, or has been announced as a plant. Context that makes the point on a valuation page: QS's own FY2026 capex guidance is tens of millions of dollars — a rounding error against a real gigafactory (see open_gaps: the two researchers gave conflicting capex guidance ranges, so no capex number is published here).

capacity.source_name: OFweek新材料网 (aggregator), 「宁德时代给固态电池定了个时间！2027，小批量」 — relaying CATL's own reply on the SZSE 互动易 investor-relations platform
capacity.notes: PRIMARY = CATL's own 互动易 answer of 2026-09-09; attribute it as 'CATL, 深交所互动易, 2026-09-09' and link OFweek only as the readable secondary. The 互动易 record was penetrated and matched verbatim via the irm.cninfo.com.cn search API, but the site is a JS single-page app that serves an empty 7.2KB shell to every deep-link format tried — there is no citable clickable primary URL (https://irm.cninfo.com.cn/ircs/company/companyDetail?stockcode=300750 is the entry point only). Do NOT present 2026-09-09 as a new disclosure or a newly 'set' timetable — it is a template answer the IR desk has given for over a year; that consistency (five-plus restatements with no capacity number ever attached) is itself the story. Do NOT write 'no GWh capacity EVER disclosed' — unprovable absolute; write 'the answer carries no GWh figure'. Trap on this same OFweek page: it quotes a third party (利元亨研究院杜义亨) forecasting China's first GWh-class all-solid-state demo lines in 2026–2027 — that is an industry-wide forecast and must not be attached to CATL. OFweek page body carries '2026-09-11 09:52 来源：OFweek新材料网'.
